description: Implementation of a helper class for constructing and caching Direct3D 9 vertex declarations within the ANGLE project, including methods for applying vertex declarations, managing cache, and handling instancing.

classes.name: VertexDeclarationCache
classes.description: A class that manages caching and application of Direct3D 9 vertex declarations to optimize rendering performance.

methods.name: VertexDeclarationCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache entries and state variables.

methods.name: ~VertexDeclarationCache
methods.description: Destructor releasing cached vertex declaration resources.

methods.name: applyDeclaration
methods.description: Configures the device with the appropriate vertex declaration based on current attributes, with caching to improve performance.

methods.name: markStateDirty
methods.description: Resets internal cache state to force reapplication of vertex declarations.
